title: Open Question Record (QST)
description: An explicit domain or behavioral ambiguity requiring clarification before dependent specifications or requirements can be finalized.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the question. When 'answered', resolved_by must reference at least one record.

blocking.description: Whether this open question blocks affected requirements or specifications from being marked active.

affects.description: Normative or composition records affected by this open question.

resolved_by.description: Records (FCT, ASM, DEC, REQ, CON) that answered or resolved this question.
